context: Strong positive momentum on 6 Oct in NIFTY (through its expiry) and SENSEX; BankNIFTY broke out only a little and was rejected, with negative momentum from 13:00 to 15:00.
plan: FLAT TO GAP UP -> BUY, WITH THE MARKET: the buyers who came in NIFTY and SENSEX took their targets and left, so there is no seated side to hunt -- identify buying-side setups.
GAP DOWN -> SAME BUY PLAN: a gap down should not come after such a positive chart and it raises the risk, but it can build a trap for the sellers -- keep looking for buying-side setups.
BANKNIFTY: few buyers came on its small breakout, and two hours of negative momentum after the rejection will have shaken them out, so they are not a target either.
